rules.weapons: Weapons add +0 to +5 to Attack rolls. Melee uses Strength, ranged uses Agility, unless the fiction supports another Ability Score. Items stack with weapon quality.
rules.armor: Armor and shields give DR against Stamina damage only. Light: no Agility penalty; Medium -1; Heavy -2; Powered/Legendary: none.

quality.name: Improvised
quality.examples: Table leg, hide wrap, makeshift shield. Anyone at any Wealth Tier.

quality.name: Light
quality.examples: Dagger, padded vest. Functional but unremarkable.

quality.name: Standard
quality.examples: Sword, chain shirt, handgun. Default for working professionals.

quality.name: Quality
quality.examples: Named blade, flak jacket, precision bow. Noticeably better.

quality.name: Masterwork
quality.examples: Exceptional craftsmanship, rare technology, combat armor.

quality.name: Legendary
quality.examples: Artifact, exo-suit, one-of-a-kind. Access is the constraint.

period_equipment.name: Dagger
period_equipment.text: Easily concealed. Common across all social classes. Bonus use: can be drawn as part of the same Action it is used.

period_equipment.name: Smallsword
period_equipment.text: Fashionable civilian weapon. Fast and precise. Bonus: +1 to Evasion rolls while wielded — the smallsword technique emphasises footwork and distance.

period_equipment.name: Cutlass
period_equipment.text: Robust naval and military blade. Resistant to the elements. Does not suffer penalties in wet or confined conditions.

period_equipment.name: Rapier
period_equipment.text: Duelist’s weapon. Long reach, devastating thrust. Special: Reach property (attack from one range band further without moving).

period_equipment.name: Military Sword / Broadsword
period_equipment.text: Heavy cavalry and infantry blade. Special: Trip property (on a hit, target DC 12 Strength or falls Prone).

period_equipment.name: Halberd / Pike
period_equipment.text: Polearm. Reach + Trip combined. Cannot be used in Close range. Requires 2 hands.

period_equipment.name: Boarding Axe
period_equipment.text: Naval tool and weapon. Crushing damage type. Can be thrown to Near range (Light +1 for thrown attacks).

period_equipment.name: War Hammer
period_equipment.text: Crushing damage type. Bonus: +1 against opponents in heavy armor (the impact transmits through plate).

period_equipment.name: Flintlock Pistol
period_equipment.text: 1 shot. Reload: 2 Actions. Range: Near. Damage type: Piercing. Misfires on a Natural 1 (weapon unusable until cleared, 1 Action).

period_equipment.name: Flintlock Musket
period_equipment.text: 1 shot. Reload: 3 Actions. Range: Far. Damage type: Piercing. Special: Piercing damage halves armor DR. Misfires on Natural 1. Requires 2 hands.

period_equipment.name: Blunderbuss
period_equipment.text: 1 shot. Reload: 3 Actions. Area: Cone 15 ft (all targets in cone roll to Deflect). Damage type: Piercing. Misfires on Natural 1.

period_equipment.name: Crossbow
period_equipment.text: 1 shot. Reload: 2 Actions. Range: Near. Damage type: Piercing. Advantage: silent — does not alert nearby enemies. Does not misfire.

period_equipment.name: Thrown Knife / Stone
period_equipment.text: Range: Near. No reload. A character carries up to 3 thrown weapons without encumbrance.

period_equipment.name: Holy Water
period_equipment.text: Against supernatural entities only: counts as a Radiant Effect activation (free, no pool cost) on a successful hit. Treat as a thrown weapon at Near range, Light +1 to hit. Consumes the vial on use. Ineffective against mundane targets.

period_equipment.name: Blessed Thurible
period_equipment.text: A censer on a chain. Counts as a divine weapon for Abjure purposes. An unblessed thurible is Improvised +0. Blessing requires a Bishop or equivalent authority — not self-administered.

period_equipment.name: Crucifix or Holy Relic
period_equipment.text: Not a weapon. Enables Abjure without the Channel skill requirement (once per scene). Requires Belief 2+. Also grants +2 to Abjure rolls for characters who do have Channel. A relic of significant provenance (bishop’s blessing, cathedral origin) grants +3 instead.

period_equipment.name: Silver-coated weapon
period_equipment.text: Any standard weapon can be silver-coated at double the base cost. Grants +1 to Attack rolls against supernatural entities specifically. Stacks with the base weapon bonus. Silver coating wears off after a major battle — requires re-application.

period_equipment.name: Salt
period_equipment.text: Ritual use only. A circle of salt (1 pouch, 10 ft radius) can contain a supernatural entity that has the Removed (Spirit) condition. The entity cannot cross the line without succeeding on a Morale check DC 16.

armor_categories.name: Light
armor_categories.text: No Agility penalty. Leather, padded vest, light tactical gear.

armor_categories.name: Medium
armor_categories.text: -1 Agility. Chain shirt, flak jacket, tactical vest.

armor_categories.name: Heavy
armor_categories.text: -2 Agility. Full plate, combat armor, blast suit.

armor_categories.name: Powered / Legendary
armor_categories.text: No Agility penalty (technology negates it). Exo-suit, enchanted plate.

armor.name: Heavy armor (plate, full plate)
armor.notes: Significant restriction. +1 DR vs Physical only.

armor.name: Buff coat (early modern)
armor.notes: Standard TL 4 armor. Pistol-proof at Close range.

armor.name: Flak jacket (modern)
armor.notes: Rifle-rated armor halves Piercing DR reduction.

armor.name: Lobster-pot helm
armor.notes: +1 DR vs called shots to the head only.

armor.name: Full harness (rare)
armor.notes: Obsolete by 1660s. Expensive. Treated as curiosity.

shields.name: Buckler
shields.benefit: Can be worn; frees weapon hand

shields.name: Round shield
shields.benefit: Shield Bash Maneuver available (+1 attack, Prone on overage 3+)

shields.name: Tower shield
shields.benefit: Full cover (melee attackers must Disarm/bypass); −1 Attack
